items.title: Apply to attend with 25% off: SUPAWEEKLY
From a Chocolate Wrapper to Concurrent InnoDB Page Splits
items.blurb: Here is a story [1] about the first version of B-link optimization for Innodb that is the most used B-tree engine in MariaDB.

items.title: Article: Implementing Chaos Engineering in Financial Payment Systems: Lessons from Enterprise ECS Deployments
items.blurb: Standard chaos engineering assumes experiments stop cleanly, blast radius is knowable in advance, and production is fair game. Payment systems violate all three.

items.title: DIFF: A Relational Interface for Large-Scale Data Explanation
items.blurb: Abstract: A range of explanation engines assist data analysts by performing feature selection over increasingly high-volume and high-dimensional data, grouping and highlighting commonalities among data points.

items.title: The Dataflow Model Revisited
items.blurb: Abstract Eleven years ago, the Dataflow Model paper argued that unbounded, out-of-order data was the new normal, and that we must stop waiting for data to ever become complete.
